title: Because the chair wobbles, so I moved to the floor.
scene: 他不坐椅子坐地上，并催爸爸修。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Why did you sit down on the floor?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Because the chair wobbles, so I moved to the floor.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Can you fix the wobbly chair for me?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: I will tighten it up for you tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: So I can sit in it again tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Yes, so you can sit in it tomorrow.

variations: "sit on the floor" 换 "stand by the window"；"wobbles" 换 "creaks"。
